balls.text: Dube holes out and CSK are bowled out for 190! This is a half-volley but a little wide, he looks to go inside out and picks out sweeper cover. Sam Curran looked to have set them up for 200-plus, but they have crumbled short of that mark! Arshdeep picks up a well deserved second wicket
Goes for the yorker, and it's a low full toss outside off, Dube swings across the line and gets a lucky inside edge through fine leg!

Noor has hit this high in the air and Chahal has a hat-trick! Jansen comes in from long-on to settle under it as Noor skies this full ball tossed up around off. Chahal does his trademark pose on the ground to celebrate. We have the first hat-trick of the season! And Chahal has his second hat-trick of the IPL!
Castled! Floated full on middle, It straightens ever so little and Kamboj plays all around it trying to whip it leg side. Golden duck for the Impact Player
Sliced to point! Floated full outside off, Hooda skips out and looks to go inside out. The ball spins away to take the leading edge and Priyansh Arya does the needful
On a length outside off, driven between deep cover and long-off for a brace
Uh oh! That's picked out long-off! Legbreak outside off and he looks to slap it down the ground, but can't clear Wadhera at long-off. Short cameo comes to an end
That is skied, and it is taken! By Jadeja in the CSK dugout! This is tossed full on middle and Dhoni skips out and lofts it down the ground. Jadeja celebrates with aplomb
Poor start from Chahal, throws it up wide  and too wide
Short on leg, Dhoni pulls it out to deep square leg. He will keep strike

Dhoni starts off with a top edge over the keeper! The man he has replaced got two boundaries like that, so almost a tribute? Just kidding. This is short and angled across him, Dhoni looks to pull and the top edge does the job

Has he nicked this? And Curran has to go! Short outside off, Curran sways out of the way but his bat is hung out there and he falls 12 short of a century. But this has been a mighty knock nonetheless from Sam Curran, who badly needed a good one!
Swing and a miss! Full around middle and leg at 138kph, and he misses the ball completely and the ball also misses the stumps
Full on leg and sliding down. Curran misses out with a flick but Jansen will have to rebowl this
Thwacked away! Short ball sits up nicely and Curran hammers the pull over midwicket!
Full around off, he looks to heave it leg side and misses out. The ball goes off his pads to the leg side

Dug in short outside off, Curran misses on the pull. This time Curran wants it reviewed for wide for height! Curran is crouching so they will have to use ball tracking. And ball tracking shows that it would have been under his head height had he been standing upright. And Arshdeep ends an excellent over where only two runs came off the bat, and two due to wides

Called wide again and Arshdeep asks for a review This did look close. PBKS do review it. Curran moved a little, so the wide line has also moved out a little, and the ball is well inside the revised line. Another successful review
Wide yorker again, this time he gets the line right, and Dube is only able to squeeze it out fine of deep point for a single
Arshdeep messes up another wide yorker. Past the line and no complaints this time
Yorker outside off again, Curran can only drive it out to long-on for a single
In the blockhole outside off, Curran can only squeeze it back out to Arshdeep's right
This time Arshdeep does overshoot the line!
Looks for the wide yorker, but that's called wide. It looked like it was inside the tramline. PBKS review it. And Arshdeep is right. That was inside the line and the decision is overturned
In the blockhole, dug out to long-on. 26 runs off that over!
Welcome to the jungle, Shedge, because Curran seems to have an appetite for destruction right now! Harmless short ball and Curran pulls it away in front of square
Another full toss and this time it's put away Crrrrunnnchhhed through extra cover!

Stunning save at the boundary! Low full toss outside off and Curran launches this to long-on's left. Shreyas Iyer grabs it jumping back and throws it into the field of play before falling to the ground. Captain fantastic!
Yorker outside off, Curran drills it straight to the cover fielder, but it's hit hard and it bursts through him, allowing them to run two. And Shedge has overstepped
Whipped off his pads! Too full again, this time on the stumps, and Curran deposits this over midwicket
Curran does line him up! This is in the slot outside off, Curran clears his front leg and slams it over long-on for an 80m six
On a length around off, punched to mid-off
Looks for the yorker, but it's slightly short of that mark on the stumps, Curran whips it out to deep midwicket
Dug in short around leg and Curran stands tall and pulls it away in front of square leg. Crunched away

Curran, coming into this match, was dead at the bottom of ESPNcricinfo's MVP list. And now he has hit a 30-ball fifty at the Chepauk! The dressing room gets up and applauds and he acknowledges them with an angry swing of the bat after making a phone-call gesture. This is full outside off, Curran drives it straight down the ground as long-off gets across. They are able to run two
On a length on middle and going across, Dube pushes it to cover's right for a single

Knocks him over! Length ball outside off, 136kph, and it nips in to beat Brevis' attempted flick. The ball hits top of off and Omarzai pumps his fists. It's been a tough outing with the ball for him so far, but he has provided a crucial breakthrough
Oooh, beaten! Length ball outside off seams in, beating Curran's flick and juuuuuust going past the off stump
Full down leg, Curran can't connect on the flick
Short outside off, cut away to deep point's right
A no-look ramp-scoop? Dug in short outside off and angled into him, Brevis gets his head out of the way and helps it over the keeper!
Short outside off, Curran pulls it wide of long-on but can only get a single. Curran jumps in frustration to see Brevis wasn't ready for the second when he wanted it
Flicked away on the bounce to deep midwicket. This was full on the pads but Brevis can't find the gap
Pace off delivery on a length outside off, Curran looks to whip it leg side and misses. The ball rolls towards point and they take the leg bye
Full and angled across Curran, who slaps it along the carpet to long-ff
On a length outside off, Curran cuts it out to deep cover
Yorker outside off, squeezed out to sweeper cover
Full outside off, squeezed out to deep cover
Back of length on leg and going across, Curran pulls it out to deep midwicket
And he concedes his first boundary! This is a length ball outside off at a gentle pace that sits up nicely and Curran swats it away wide of long-on
Lovely yorker outside off. Brevis tries to bring his bat down to squeeze it out but it skids under it
On a length outside off, tucked out to deep square leg
Deftly played. Full and angling down leg, there is a short fine leg and Curran tucks it straight of him and fine enough of deep square leg
Sliced away to deep point. Full outside off, Brevis meets it with a big swing of the bat, but can't quite get a hold of it
Slower ball, full and wide, Brevis leaves as it goes past the tramline
Short outside off and angling into him, Curran pulls it to deep midwicket's right and gets a single

Top edge over the keeper!! Not the first time today for Sam Curran. Angled into him from outside off and Curran looks to pull this away. He won't mind the end result even if that wasn't quite to plan. CSK's 100 comes up, and the fifty partnership is also up
Short outside off but it seams across Brevis and goes down leg. Inglis can't cleanly collect as it bounces right in front of him and they get the extra run
Length ball outside off, driven square to deep point. Shedge with a quiet over
Full outside off, worked down the ground towards long-on
Length ball angling in from outside off, tucked away to deep midwicket
Full around off from around the wicket to the left-handed Curran, tucked into the vacant mid-on region. Shedge hurries across to chase it down
Short outside off, this time Brevis is able to ppull it away to deep midwicket
Starts off with a short ball outside off, Brevis looks to cut but can't connect
slower one at 117kmh outside off, Brevis bunts it down towards mid off and gets a quick single
he angles it in and strikes the pads, but this is going down leg. Omarzai was the only one appealing in vain
angling in and he taps it down to long on for one
on the stumps again and he works it down to long on for one this time
much straighter on middle and leg, he leans into it and flicks it away to leg for two in the gap

superbly executed for four! This ball is just short of length, just outside off, nothing terribly wrong with that. But Brevis gets in such good position to get on top of that by jumping in the crease and unleashing a fiery cut behind square on the off side
big swing for the ball tossed up, doesn't middle it but gets some bat and a single to midwicket for one
but this one's too short and dispatched for six! Brevis pounces on the short ball this time, rocks back and packs some power into that pull to hit possibly the biggest six of the night
nicely bowled! Some flight outside off that lit up Brevis' eyes, but it was slow too and made him wait for it. Eventually went for the cut and missed
slows it up on leg stump now, 87.1kmh, and Curran tickles it away off the pads for one
really short on leg, Curran opens up his stance in a flash and whacks that slap in the gap for four more! Wide gap between long on and deep midwicket and placed it nicely there
80.2kmh, pitched up on middle, too straight with his legspin, and Curran middles that sweep to send that crashing to the boundary for four
outside off with the angle and Curran opens the face of the bat late to steer it past point for one
fires it in outside off, he cuts off the back foot for one
over long on for six! There's a fielder at the boundary there but Curran takes the risk, charges down and swings straight down to send the ball into the stands
leans towards off of the length ball on middle and leg, and he clips it square to leg for one
in the block hole on middle, with the angle, and Brevis bunts it back to Brar
pitches it up on off to Curran, swung across the line and along the ground to wide long on for one
just outside off, not much turn and Brevis cuts off the back foot to deep point
down leg and turning down as well, he pulls it away to deep square leg for one. Got away with that one
shorter outside off, no turn again, and it's not that short but Brevis' quick arm speed slaps it back past the bowler to long on for one
straighter on the pads, and it's clipped square for one
a legbreak tight outside off, he cuts it away and gets one after a fumble from point
tosses it up on middle stump with some drift, he waits and turns it to leg for one
he darts it in towards middle stump and Brevis defends it back carefully

the keeper Inglis is celebrating for caught behind! The umpire shakes his head and Inglis asks his captain to review it straightaway. Jadeja went for the cut as Brar made the line tighter, there's a spike on UltraEdge and Brar has the last laugh! A few loose deliveries and Brar then redeems himself
fires it in outside off, this isn't as wide but still short and wide enough for Jadeja to rock back and slice that away for another four
too short this time, there's plenty of width as well and Jadeja cracks a boundary with a powerful cut. Second loose delivery in three balls
swings across the line as the length is pulled back slightly, straight to midwicket
tosses it up first ball well outside off, and Jadeja smokes that one back straight down over mid off for a one-bounce four. Jadeja needs such deliveries early on and this one was right up there
on the pads to Curran as well, he nudges it square with some wonderful wristwork and gets two
length delivery on leg this time, clips it on the leg side for one
finally middles one and clears the fielder in the circle too! Short ball on leg, Jadeja pivots on the back foot and dispatches that over short fine leg with a late pull to get off the mark
short and into the body, Jadeja pulls this time into the ground and finds midwicket
short and wide, Jadeja gets room but can't clear cover with that slap
length ball on middle and off, Curran gets an inside edge onto his pad and they scamper across for one
136.8kmh, pushes at the ball outside off with his feet cemented to the crease, it's a single to deep third

a top edge straight over the keeper's head for four. Completely miscues the pull because the short ball is outside off, he's not close enough to the line of the ball, it results in a leading edge and luckily for Curran nowhere close to the fielders
more towards the pads now, Jadeja charges down and wants to whack it away square but can only get a leg bye for that
length ball this time, swinging away in the end with first slip waiting, and Jadeja withdraws his bat in the end
hello, Jadeja! Bangs in a bouncer first ball outside off which Jadeja ducks under just in time

Mhatre is gone as well! Pitched wide outside off, Mhatre has an open stance and he wants to go over the top but he can't clear mid off, where Shreyas goes to his left for a tumble and grabs it with both hands
130.6kmh, slightly slower to end the over. Outside off, Curran miscues the drive meant for the covers to leg and it ends with a dot
welcomes Curran with a bouncer first ball, angling towards leg, and he lets it go for a wide, called by the square leg umpire

gone this time! He wants more boundaries in the over, completely mistimes the wobbled seam delivery outside off by going for a big shot, and he skies it to extra cover which Shashank settles under easily
and six more! Rasheed is catching up quickly. Short and down leg, Rasheed middles a handsome pull, with fine leg in the circle, and sends that into the crowd right off the meat of the bat
he makes room again, this time a length ball on middle and leg, and he punches it towards extra cover. It was a slow offcutter, so hard to smash it away easily

Rasheed finally connects with one nicely and he's middled that full delivery back over the bowler's head for four. He makes room early on, gets one pitched up and opens up his arms for a good looking straight drive
another wide down the leg side, past the pads and the bat
inswinging yorker this time on middle, and Mhatre digs it out straight down the ground for one
swings it in, but it's the wrong line down the leg side and called a wide
wonderful line outside off with some inswing, Rasheed misses his hard-handed cut again
swinging in from leg stump this time and Rasheed goes for a big swing but he doesn't connect at all. Takes it on the pad outside leg for a stifled appeal
well outside off to Rasheed with good pace, he cuts and misses as the ball swings in late
goes for a big shot on leg this time as Janses pitches it shorter on leg, does't quite middle it and gets one to fine leg
more towards off, a hint of swing and Mhatre cleverly dabs it late enough with the perfect timing to send that for four between the keeper and short third. First boundary of the night!
132.1kmh, starts on middle stump line and Mhatre defends it back off the back foot
follows the bouncer with a full delivery on the stumps as the batter charges down and smashes it back, but Arshdeep stops it in his follow through. He has hurt his hand a little but but looks ok
he bangs it in short, as expected, on middle stump line and Rasheed leaves it alone eventually after he thought of ramping. Called a wide for the height
bit of a mix up after Rasheed turns the outswinging ball from off stump to midwicket and takes off for the run, before he's sent back in time
outswing now, first up to Mhatre and the young man waits before steering the ball towards backward point. Off the mark as well
inswing this time into the batter from middle and leg, and Rasheed clips it square to get off the mark
lovely outswing, shaping the ball from leg to off with a shorter length and Rasheed taps the ball towards point
starts with a length ball outside off which Rasheed blocks with a forward lean

Inside edged for four and PBKS win! Length ball angled across, Jansen looks to pull and gets it past the stumps and Dhoni! CSK are officially out of contention for the playoff race. Punjab Kings, though, are back in the top four with a hard-fought win in the end!
Uh oh! This is a length ball across him, steered to the point fielder. Dot ball!
Short on leg, and oh my! Shedge pulls it to the deep midwicket fielder! Noor holds on, and PBKS will have to wait for victory
Now it's a length ball down leg, and it's given wide. Scores are level

Short on leg, Shedge backs away to cut but is beaten. And now he reviews for the wide. Shedge is standing tall at the crease, but I think Khaleel will be okay here. Yep, that's just under Shedge's head height
Full toss around leg, Inglis looks to whip it away but misses out
Full outside off, Shedge gets an inside edge now as he pushes at it and it rolls to long leg
Bowled'im! This is full outside off, stays a little low too, Iyer looks to swing it away but gets an inside edge onto the stumps
Another yorker on middle, Inglis backs away and looks to squeeze it on the off side but it comes off the inside edge fine on the leg side
Yorker on off, squeezed out towards midwicket for a single
146kph yorker around leg, tucked behind square. Actually that went off the pads
Inglis with another reverse-sweep but it goes to the fielder in the deep this time
Nails the reverse-sweep! This is full around middle and off, reverse-swept straight of the short third fielder and deep backward point can't get it either
Tossed up around off, pushed back to the bowler

Has Brevis pulled off a catch for the ages? Shashank takes on this short ball and pulls it over midwicket. Brevis at deep midwicket grabs it while jumping. He throws it up before he lands, jumps to hold it again and realises he may not be landing inside the rope so he throws it up again before completing the catch on the third attempt! The umpire is having a check. And Shashank has to go! What brilliant fielding from Brevis there. I am sure there will be plenty of internet debates about this one! But it's a catch to remember from the young South African!
Oh and this one goes all the way! This is a rank long hop, Shashank waits on it and launches this over long-off
Beats long-on! It's on a length outside off and Shashank slaps it down the groiund with a straight bat and it beats the fielder running to his left
Short outside off, dabbed to short third's right for a quick single

Shreyas slices it on the off side looking to go inside out but it lands well short of deep point running in. Everything going Iyer's way right now. This was full around off and he got it off the outside half of the bat

Oh, so deftly played! Shreyas is toying with CSK right now! Pathirana couldn't have done much better there, with a yorker just outside off, swinging in late as well. Iyer waits on it and jams down the bat with the open face to get it between backward point and short third
Now Pathirana gets the yorker away, but it's down leg!
Two in a row! Slot ball outside off again and this time Iyer hammers this wide of long-on
Oh what a shot! Pathirana misses a yorker, it turns into a slot ball, and Iyer clears his front leg and clubs it over long-on
Full outside off, 147kph, Shashank goes across the stumps and drives this down to long-on
Tossed up around leg, Shashank goes for the sweep again but this time it goes to deep square leg on the bounce
On a length and Shashank hoicks this between long-on and deep midwicket and they get two
Full toss outside leg, Shreyas looks to swing it away fine down leg and miscues it to short fine
Googly outside leg, Shashank looks to play it to the leg side but gets a leading edge that bobs to the bowler's left
On a length around middle, going across him and he pushes it back towards the bowler
Oh that's into the stands! Tossed up in the slot around leg and Shashank is down on one knee and he nails the sweep over square leg
On a length outside off, Shreyas whips this away to midwicket's left. Long-off does well to slide and stop this. PBKS get two.
Full on the stumps, squeezed out through square leg for a single
Can't connect first ball. Length ball outside off beats the outside edge

And this time the full toss pays dividends! Low full toss outside off, Wadhera skips out and looks to open the face to steer it on the off side but he hits it straight to Jadeja, who takes a good low catch with the ball flying at him
Another full toss, and this time Pathirana doesn't get a reprieve. Wadhera hits a punchy drive between mid-off and extra cover. Lovely placement, and timing
Full toss on the pads but Iyer can't capitalise. Whipped away to deep square leg on the bounce
Full outside off, swung out to deep midwicket's left off the inside half of the bat. And Shreyas has got to a 32-ball 50.
Crashed through covers! Overpitched outside off and Shreyas drives it and drives it hard
Slapped back over the bowler's head. This is a length ball outside off and Shreyas flat-bats this straight down. They race for two
Shreyas Iyer has picked the bones out of this one! He waits on the slower ball outside off and effortlessly launches this over long-on
On a length on off, flicked off his pads to deep backward square
Slower ball on a length outside off, Shreyas hoicks it out to deep midwicket on the bounce

Noor finally strikes! Prabhsimran goes for the slog sweep as Noor goes full on the stumps but he can't get the requisite distance on that. That was a back-of-the-hand delivery and Prabh picks out Brevis at deep midwicket. He makes no mistake, the youngster
Length ball angled across, slapped out to deep cover

And that's swatted away! Iyer rocks back to this long hop and hammers this over long-on. Brevis at the rope leaps to try and grab it, but it's well over him but he trips on the boundary rope and seems to have hurt his shoulder a little thanks to the awkward landing

Dropped! Prabh skips down the ground to this full ball on leg and looks to go downtown, but gets a leading edge that loops to Pathirana's right at short third. but the fast bowler makes a meal of it! That wasn't a difficult chance at all
On a length around off, Shreyas rocks back to pull it out to long-on on the bounce
Wrong'un on a length on off, cut to backward point
Full outside off, Shreyas looks to whip it leg side, but the lack of pace - 83.8kph - deceives him. Gets an inside edge through backward square leg
Oh that lands safe! 106kph slower bouncer around off, Prabhsimran is cramped on the pull and gets a top edge that flies square on the leg side. The fielder from the deep is not close enough
Length ball outside off, swung away along the ground to deep midwicket
Another slower ball, in the blockhole wide of off, Prabhsimran works it down to long-on
Slower ball around middle, at just 81.2kph, and Prabhsimran waits and blocks it to the bowler's right. Curran though seems to have hurt his angle trying to stop that
Full outside off, drilled down the ground to long-on's left
Length ball outside off and Prabhsimran gets low and cuts this away through backward point! Fifty up for Prabhsimran! Back-to-back half-centuries for the PBKS opener
Short outside off, Iyer looks to pull and gets a bottom edge in front of square leg
Clipped out to deep backward square. This was a yorker around leg
Mix-up and Prabhsimran survives! Clips this full ball and takes off for the single, but Shreyas sends him back. The throw is wide at the striker's end, but he had made his ground regardless
That's massive! Pure whippage from Prabhsimran as Pathirana bowls this in the slot on the pads. Lofted over midwicket and the fifty-partnership is up off 35 balls
Just short of good length around off, Shreyas drops it in front on the leg side for a quick single
Starts off with a length ball that swings down leg
slow again, this time not as short and bunted down to long on

late cut over short third for four. Curran has been bowling short and wide this over, but with short third in the circle, Shreyas knew getting even some bat on that to steer it over and wide of him would be enough

falls safe and short of Jadeja running in from the boundary! Pitched up on off, he lofts it straight down, but actually miscues it towards wide long on, Jadeja runs in from deep midwicket and you can't do much if he can't get there
slow, short and not as wide, Prabhsimran goes for the cut around shoulder height and misses
crashes the short ball over point with some force and it reaches deep point after a bounce
short and outside off, Shreyas cuts and gets the inner half of the bat towards point
outside off to Shreyas, driven through the covers for one
more on the leg side and it's clipped away to leg for one
crashed for a straight six! Dances down, gets to the pitch of the ball before it can turn this way or that, and smashes it back over the bowler
full and almost on the front shoe, and he replies with a powerful paddle to send that racing to the fine leg boundary
much shorter around off, and he pulls it away for one
beaten outside off with a wrong'un! He wants to drive into the covers but misses the line and Dhoni can't collect it cleanly to try for the stumping as Shreyas' back foot had slipped out for a moment
he goes for the reverse again, this time it's much shorter and just outside off, and he finally connects to send that racing to the boundary for four
he goes back for this and turns it to deep midwicket for one more
straight on the stumps from good length, he goes back and across and turns it to leg for one
on the off side this time and he punches that down to mid off

just beats deep fine leg and tha's almost gone all the way! Goes down on a knee quickly because Jadeja is not bowling slow, middles that sweep for the ball sliding down leg, and sends it sailing to the right of the fielder. It's four in fact
fired in towards middle and leg, he defends it back
short and wide, lots of room, and Shreyas whacks it away to deep point
a touch fuller on off, Shreyas goes across and he turns it to the leg side again off the back foot. The field is spread out so they hare back for the second
97.4kmh, fired in on leg stump, Prabhsimran also works it to leg for one more
turning into middle and off now, he whips it away for one to leg
flat and angling away outside off, it's the googly, and he misses the cut
starts with a slow delivery tossed up outside leg, nudged on the leg side easily for one
on the pads to end the over as well, and Shreyas picks that gap wide of short fine leg to find that boundary with smart placement. Makes it six off the over after just two singles earlier
on the pads this time, and he tickles it fine on the leg side for a quick one
punches off the back foot this time, for a thick edge to short third

another reverse attempt, another miss, and this one is much straighter, perhaps close to off stump and CSK review this not out decision. Dhoni signals for the T, here we go. He's hit on the front pad, around the knee roll but he's down on the back knee. So height may not be an issue on this pitch. Let's see for the edge and the line. No bat, and ball-tracking says it's Umprie's call on Impact. Very close. because that was otherwise hitting the stumps!
he goes for the reverse early, Jadeja fires it in outside off, and he misses
towards middle stump with the angle, and Shreyas goes back to clip it to leg
gets some room outside off and he slams that back down in the V, to the left of mid off where Dube puts his body behind it to save a few
angles it into the stumps and Shreyas can't get bat on it. On the pad but going down leg so the half-hearted appeal dies quickly

he has him caught behind, Khaleel gets the sweet revenge! Full marks to him for persisting with the short length despite being hit for four earlier. Bangs in a good bouncer that comes in, doesn't give Arya much room, this has good bounce too, and takes the edge behind for the almost tumbling Dhoni to take it with both hands to his right
short and almost out of his reach again, but this time Arya's attempt to chase ends up in a thick edge which flies through the slip region with Dhoni left watching
good reply from Khaleel. He bangs it in short again, but this time well far from Arya outside off, and he misses it
too short to Arya and he doesn't miss those. Stands tall to get on top of that and whacks it away with nobody in the deep there
scooped away for four! Who said Prabhsimran is all about power? He goes across early and predicts the yorker nicely, sets up nicely by going low and scoops that really fine
he keeps backing away and Kamboj does well to follow him with the line, it goes off the pad for a leg bye
stays in the crease this time and gently pushes into the cover to rotate the strike
dances down again, and scythes this one with some power square of the wicket. Straight to point
charges again, gives it heave down the ground and he's sent that all the way! Don't think he middled it like it does, but such is his brute force that hitting it 80-90% fine also takes it all the way
backs away early for the short of length ball outside off and gives it a bash down to mid off
a slow offcutter into the pitch outside off, he taps it away to the right of first slip and lazily goes for the run. Jadeja even made him hurry in the end while trying for the direct hit
aims for the stumps with the angle, and Arya helps it to leg for one
short of length outside off now, he waits and taps it square for one
swatted late to the right of deep fine leg where the fielder sprints before putting in a slide with legs in front and kicks the ball too, but only to the boundary rope
